purpose: Low-overhead boot index. This file is a derived operational index, not canonical research truth.

research_team.rule: Evidence outranks researcher rank; Claude Code adjudicates unresolved architecture/research decisions after evidence review.

research_center.trigger_room_rule: An exact scientific/research-center trigger pins the session to the same-named home room. Meta triggers fusion/hypofusion use center and dump uses intake.
research_center.same_topic_rule: If multiple useful workers are active in the same home room, they autonomously form an ephemeral tAvern-style team epoch with leased CHEF/ABYSS/FORGE/CARTOGRAPHER/REPLICATOR/SYNTHESIZER roles. CHEF coordinates but has no epistemic authority.
research_center.cross_room_rule: Workers remain trigger-loyal while selectively consuming and publishing relevant cross-room deltas through the repo.
research_center.pulse_rule: Active workers reread room/cross-room state at mandatory decision boundaries before major choices or durable writes.

research_task_routing.fallback: If a planned provider cannot be used because of quota, rate limit, runtime, credentials or provider availability, continue with the best legacy research method and record the limitation.

status_footer_rendering.rule: For every substantive visible response, render exactly one final plain fenced text footer. Never use ```text id=... or Unicode box/table layouts. GitHub STATUS_FOOTER_PROTOCOL.md overrides older Project Source rendering examples.

dump.instruction: Execute the full dump research cycle immediately; do not ask the user what dump means.

fusion.instruction: Research across the complete current RAE graph/evidence classes and write explicit feedback or NO_CHANGE receipts to every registered scientific branch.

hypofusion.instruction: Screen all reachable current/open hypotheses plus fresh live-worker material against broad external support, analogues, better mechanisms, nulls, failure modes and counterhypotheses; preserve evidence classes; generate discriminating tests; then execute whole-mesh Fusion 2 and feedback to every registered scientific branch.

T1_TASK_ROUTING: research_entity/rooms/ROOM_DB_SCHEMA.json for trigger sessions or cross-worker coordination
tools/research_room.py when a repository working tree is available
research_entity/global/DUMP_PROTOCOL.md only when reserved command dump is triggered
research_entity/triggers/FUSION_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md only when reserved command fusion is triggered
research_entity/triggers/HYPOFUSION_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md only when reserved command hypofusion is triggered
T2_ONLY_WHEN_RELEVANT: home-room event/task/challenge detail beyond compact pulse
T3_AUDIT_OR_STATE_CHANGE: full room event history when reconstructing a disputed room state

context_budget_defaults.overflow_policy: load indexes/summaries/pulses first; fetch evidence detail only on demand
context_budget_defaults.fusion_override: coverage-first traversal may exceed normal branch packet limits via staged/indexed retrieval; do not silently omit a branch or evidence class

architecture_frontier: backend-neutral set-valued hyperposition + faceted active projection
adaptive selective coupling with overcoupling tripwire
new_first_class_research_target: Android/edge execution of FRANK-compatible runtime with local Qwen-4B-class inference
fallback: If canonical, membership or actor verification fails, enter DEGRADED_UNJOINED and never claim canonical writes. If room operations cannot be written, continue trigger research locally but mark room coordination SYNC_PENDING and never claim peer synchronization.
